document.title: crawl.cheap Engineering Blog
document.description: Firecrawl-compatible edge web scraping, Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl, and @theme.tools architecture guides.

items.title: Firecrawl-Compatible Edge Scraping: High-Throughput Markdown Extraction for RAG and AI Agents
items.summary: OpenAPI contract parity, headless browser rendering pools, anti-bot etiquette, and deterministic HTML-to-Markdown distillation.

items.title: Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl & Hibernatable Durable Objects: Distributed Web Crawling with WebSocket Watchers
items.summary: How crawl.cheap orchestrates Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl, Hibernatable WebSocket Durable Objects, Markdown for Agents, and HMAC-SHA256 lifecycle webhooks at half of Firecrawl pricing.

items.title: OAuth 2.1 PKCE, Better Auth & 30-Tool Remote MCP Servers: Zero-Trust Web Data Pipelines for AI Agents
items.summary: Complete engineering specification for running RFC 9728 / RFC 8414 OAuth 2.1 with PKCE S256, Google/GitHub/Magic-Link Better Auth, and all 30 Firecrawl MCP tools on Cloudflare Workers.

items.title: 11-Format Document Parsing & Autonomous Browser Co-Pilots: Workers AI toMarkdown(), Vectorize RAG & 7-Rail Telemetry
items.summary: Engineering deep-dive into converting PDF, Office, ODF, CSV, RTF, and images to Markdown at the edge, driving persistent Puppeteer sessions with plain-English prompts, and tracing every LLM span with a 2,500ms circuit breaker.
